title: The Struggle of Getting a License Plate
synopsis: Getting a license plate in Beijing is not easy. Learn about what that process is like.

fullText.simplified:
买车容易上牌儿难

    为了控制环境污染，缓解北京交通拥堵问题，2011年开始，北京政府采用摇号的方式限制购车。摇号的意思就是满足申请条件的人，可以在网络上提出申请，申请通过后，再去政府官网摇号，通过摇号得到车牌。说白了就是：即使你买得起车，因为没有车牌，买了车也没用。
    什么人有资格摇号呢？北京户口的人可以摇号；在北京工作，连续缴纳五年社保和个税的外地人可以摇号；满足申请条件的外国朋友也可以摇号。这些条件看似简单，但是想要都满足可没那么容易，所以有一大批人没有资格申请摇号。即使能够申请，也因为摇号的人数太多，一时半会得不到车牌。
    摇号政策刚出的几年，人们还可以通过上外地牌照买车。可是后来，管理越来越严格。从2019年12月开始，北京政府规定：外地车牌的车进入北京，每个月只有七天的停留资格，超过时间会受到处罚。这样一来，一些有外地牌照的车主就没办法继续在北京使用自己的车了。
    2020年，北京政府又推出了新政策：可以以家庭为单位申请摇号。也就是说，只要一个人有驾照，其他家人也可以跟着一起申请摇号。这个政策听起来好像对无车家庭来说是有利的，但是每期三千多人摇号抢一个车牌的情况，还是让很多申请人觉得希望不大。
    很多没车想买车的人认为：政府应该多推出一些政策，比如收回一些外地人上的北京牌照，或者禁止一个人名下有多辆车等，这样可以缓解目前摇号人数太多的情况。
    总之一句话，如果一个人想要在北京摇到号，买到车，需要有足够的耐心。
fullText.traditional:
買車容易上牌兒難

    為了控制環境污染，緩解北京交通擁堵問題，2011年開始，北京政府採用搖號的方式限制購車。搖號的意思就是滿足申請條件的人，可以在網絡上提出申請，申請通過後，再去政府官網搖號，通過搖號得到車牌。說白了就是：即使你買得起車，因為沒有車牌，買了車也沒用。
    什麼人有資格搖號呢？北京戶口的人可以搖號；在北京工作，連續繳納五年社保和個稅的外地人可以搖號；滿足申請條件的外國朋友也可以搖號。這些條件看似簡單，但是想要都滿足可沒那麼容易，所以有一大批人沒有資格申請搖號。即使能夠申請，也因為搖號的人數太多，一時半會得不到車牌。
    搖號政策剛出的幾年，人們還可以通過上外地牌照買車。可是後來，管理越來越嚴格。從2019年12月開始，北京政府規定：外地車牌的車進入北京，每個月只有七天的停留資格，超過時間會受到處罰。這樣一來，一些有外地牌照的車主就沒辦法繼續在北京使用自己的車了。
    2020年，北京政府又推出了新政策：可以以家庭為單位申請搖號。也就是說，只要一個人有駕照，其他家人也可以跟著一起申請搖號。這個政策聽起來好像對無車家庭來說是有利的，但是每期三千多人搖號搶一個車牌的情況，還是讓很多申請人覺得希望不大。
    很多沒車想買車的人認為：政府應該多推出一些政策，比如收回一些外地人上的北京牌照，或者禁止一個人名下有多輛車等，這樣可以緩解目前搖號人數太多的情況。
    總之一句話，如果一個人想要在北京搖到號，買到車，需要有足夠的耐心。

sentences.traditional: 通過搖號得到車牌。
sentences.pinyin: tōng guò yáo hào dé dào chē pái
sentences.english: After their applications are approved, they can then go to the official website and enter the lottery.

sentences.simplified: 说白了就是：即使你买得起车，因为没有车牌，买了车也没用。
sentences.traditional: 說白了就是：即使你買得起車，因為沒有車牌，買了車也沒用。

sentences.english: They can then get a license plate if they are successful in the lottery.
To put it plainly: even if you can afford a car, buying a car is pointless if you don’t have a license plate.

sentences.simplified: 什么人有资格摇号呢？
sentences.traditional: 什麼人有資格搖號呢？

sentences.traditional: 在北京工作，連續繳納五年社保和個稅的外地人可以搖號；

sentences.english: People with household registration in Beijing can enter the lottery.

sentences.simplified: 满足申请条件的外国朋友也可以摇号。
sentences.traditional: 滿足申請條件的外國朋友也可以搖號。
sentences.pinyin: mǎn zú shēn qǐng tiáo jiàn de wài guó péng you yě kě yǐ yáo hào
sentences.english: Non-locals working in Beijing who have paid social insurance and personal income taxes for five consecutive years can enter the lottery.

sentences.simplified: 这些条件看似简单，但是想要都满足可没那么容易，
sentences.traditional: 這些條件看似簡單，但是想要都滿足可沒那麼容易，
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē tiáo jiàn kàn sì jiǎn dān dàn shì xiǎng yào dōu mǎn zú kě méi nà me róng yì
sentences.english: Foreigners who meet the application requirements can also enter the lottery.

sentences.traditional: 所以有一大批人沒有資格申請搖號。

sentences.english: These requirements are seemingly simple, but it’s not easy to meet all of them.

sentences.simplified: 即使能够申请，也因为摇号的人数太多，一时半会得不到车牌。
sentences.traditional: 即使能夠申請，也因為搖號的人數太多，一時半會得不到車牌。
sentences.pinyin: jí shǐ néng gòu shēn qǐng yě yīn wèi yáo hào de rén shù tài duō yì shí bàn huì dé bú dào chē pái
sentences.english: So, there is a large number of people who are not eligible to apply for the lottery.
Even if you are eligible to apply, because many people enter the lottery, it will take some time to get a license plate.

sentences.english: In the first few years after the launch of the lottery policy, people could still buy cars using non-local license plates.

sentences.traditional: 這樣一來，一些有外地牌照的車主就沒辦法繼續在北京使用自己的車了。

sentences.english: .. could only stay in Beijing for seven days every month, with penalties imposed for exceeding this time limit.
As a result, some car owners with non-local license plates were unable to continue using their cars in Beijing.

sentences.traditional: 2020年，北京政府又推出了新政策：可以以家庭為單位申請搖號。

sentences.traditional: 也就是說，只要一個人有駕照，其他家人也可以跟著一起申請搖號。

sentences.english: In 2020, the Beijing government launched a new policy: one may enter the lottery as part of a family unit.

sentences.simplified: 这个政策听起来好像对无车家庭来说是有利的，
sentences.traditional: 這個政策聽起來好像對無車家庭來說是有利的，
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge zhèng cè tīng qi lai hǎo xiàng duì wú chē jiā tíng lái shuō shì yǒu lì de
sentences.english: In other words, as long as one person has a driver’s license, his or her family members may also apply for the lottery.

sentences.simplified: 但是每期三千多人摇号抢一个车牌的情况，
sentences.traditional: 但是每期三千多人搖號搶一個車牌的情況，
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì měi qī sān qiān duō rén yáo hào qiǎng yí ge chē pái de qíng kuàng
sentences.english: This policy appears to benefit families that do not own a car.

sentences.simplified: 还是让很多申请人觉得希望不大。
sentences.traditional: 還是讓很多申請人覺得希望不大。
sentences.pinyin: hái shì ràng hěn duō shēn qǐng rén jué de xī wàng bú dà
sentences.english: However, the fact that around three thousand people are fighting for each license plate in each lottery draw, ..
.. means that many applicants believe that their chances are slim.

sentences.simplified: 很多没车想买车的人认为：政府应该多推出一些政策，
sentences.traditional: 很多沒車想買車的人認為：政府應該多推出一些政策，
sentences.pinyin: hěn duō méi chē xiǎng mǎi chē de rén rèn wéi zhèng fǔ yīng gāi duō tuī chū yì xiē zhèng cè

sentences.simplified: 比如收回一些外地人上的北京牌照，
sentences.traditional: 比如收回一些外地人上的北京牌照，
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú shōu huí yì xiē wài dì rén shàng de běi jīng pái zhào
sentences.english: Many people who do not own a car but would like to buy a car think that the government should launch more policies.

sentences.simplified: 或者禁止一个人名下有多辆车等，
sentences.traditional: 或者禁止一個人名下有多輛車等，
sentences.pinyin: huò zhě jìn zhǐ yí ge rén míng xià yǒu duō liàng chē děng
sentences.english: For example, recalling Beijing license plates belonging to non-locals, ..

sentences.simplified: 这样可以缓解目前摇号人数太多的情况。
sentences.traditional: 這樣可以緩解目前搖號人數太多的情況。
sentences.pinyin: zhè yàng kě yǐ huǎn jiě mù qián yáo hào rén shù tài duō de qíng kuàng
sentences.english: .. or banning the ownership of multiple cars under one person’s name.
This can help to alleviate the issue of having too many people in the lottery.

sentences.simplified: 总之一句话，如果一个人想要在北京摇到号，买到车，
sentences.traditional: 總之一句話，如果一個人想要在北京搖到號，買到車，

sentences.simplified: 需要有足够的耐心。
sentences.traditional: 需要有足夠的耐心。
sentences.pinyin: xū yào yǒu zú gòu de nài xīn
sentences.english: In short, if someone wants to get a license plate through the lottery and buy a car in Beijing, ..
.. they need to have ample patience.

sentence_translations: It’s Easy to Buy a Car, but Difficult to Get a License Plate
In order to control environmental pollution and to ease Beijing’s traffic congestion, ..
.. starting in 2011, the Beijing government has adopted a lottery system in order to limit car purchases.
The lottery system means that people who meet the requirements can submit their applications online.
After their applications are approved, they can then go to the official website and enter the lottery.
They can then get a license plate if they are successful in the lottery.
To put it plainly: even if you can afford a car, buying a car is pointless if you don’t have a license plate.
So who can enter the lottery?
People with household registration in Beijing can enter the lottery.
Non-locals working in Beijing who have paid social insurance and personal income taxes for five consecutive years can enter the lottery.
Foreigners who meet the application requirements can also enter the lottery.
These requirements are seemingly simple, but it’s not easy to meet all of them.
So, there is a large number of people who are not eligible to apply for the lottery.
Even if you are eligible to apply, because many people enter the lottery, it will take some time to get a license plate.
In the first few years after the launch of the lottery policy, people could still buy cars using non-local license plates.
But subsequently, the supervision has become increasingly strict.
Starting from December 2019, the Beijing government stipulated that cars with non-local license plates entering Beijing, ..
.. could only stay in Beijing for seven days every month, with penalties imposed for exceeding this time limit.
As a result, some car owners with non-local license plates were unable to continue using their cars in Beijing.
In 2020, the Beijing government launched a new policy: one may enter the lottery as part of a family unit.
In other words, as long as one person has a driver’s license, his or her family members may also apply for the lottery.
This policy appears to benefit families that do not own a car.
However, the fact that around three thousand people are fighting for each license plate in each lottery draw, ..
.. means that many applicants believe that their chances are slim.
Many people who do not own a car but would like to buy a car think that the government should launch more policies.
For example, recalling Beijing license plates belonging to non-locals, ..
.. or banning the ownership of multiple cars under one person’s name.
This can help to alleviate the issue of having too many people in the lottery.
In short, if someone wants to get a license plate through the lottery and buy a car in Beijing, ..
.. they need to have ample patience.
